answer: Yes, per the spec: a signed-in user can register a device via POST /v1/devices. But the code does not implement this route.
explanation: Rule R31 says POST /v1/devices takes the device fields and answers 201, with 200 when the push_token is already registered (R32). The access matrix lists ann for this route (200/201/422). The implemented app has no such route (spec_only), so the feature is required but not implemented.

citations.quote: `POST /v1/devices` takes `{installation_id, platform, push_token, timezone, app_version}` and answers 201 with the device
spec_only: the spec names this endpoint; the code registers no such route
